SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

Bubbling Well Daily Report of July 3, 1933.

ILLEGAL
UNCTIONING.

At about 2.45 p.m. on the 2/7/33, S.P.C.
459 on duty at Edinburgh and Yu Yuen Roads
informed F.S. 364 Malley that he had been
having some difficulty with a Chinese hawker
who refused to move when requested to.

The hawker moved a few yards along the
Edinburgh Road when ordered to move on by
F.S. Malley and then stopped again, and when
the above officer attempted to arrest him he
caught hold of a tree and called out and attracted
the attention of Chapei Policeman No. 3419 who was
on duty on the Edinburgh Road.

Mr. Lawrence, residing at No. 26 Tifeng Road, who
was passing in his car, offered to assist F.S. Malley
by bringing the hawker to the Station in his car.

The Chapei Policeman then ordered Mr. Lawrence
to drive to the Chapei Sub-Station on the Edinburgh
Road, and upon him refusing to do so he jumped on
to the running board of the car and accompanied him
to the Bubbling Well Station, where after being
informed that the incident occurred on a Municipal
Road and was a matter of the Settlement Authorities
to deal with, he was escorted back to Edinburgh Road.

Hawker charged at Station.

静安寺捕房1933年7月3日日报。

非法
行使职权。

1933年7月2日下午约2时45分，在爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）与愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）执勤的华籍巡长（S.P.C.）459号向副巡官（F.S.）364号马利（Malley）报告称，他在要求一名中国小贩离开时遭到拒绝，因而发生了一些争执。

当副巡官马利命令该小贩离开时，小贩沿爱丁堡路移动了几码，随后又停下。当上述警官试图逮捕他时，小贩抱住一棵树并大声呼救，引起了正在爱丁堡路执勤的闸北警察第3419号的注意。

居住在提丰路（Tifeng Road）26号的劳伦斯（Lawrence）先生驾车路过，主动提出协助副巡官马利，用他的汽车将小贩带往捕房。

随后，那名闸北警察命令劳伦斯先生将车开往位于爱丁堡路的闸北分捕房。在劳伦斯先生拒绝后，该警察跳上汽车的脚踏板，随车一同前往静安寺捕房。在被告知事件发生在工部局道路上，属于租界当局管辖范围后，该警察被护送回爱丁堡路。

小贩在捕房被起诉。

ILLEGAL
FUNCTIONING.- Extract from Bubbling Well Station Daily Report of June 8.-

At 9.30 a.m. on June 7, Motor car No.6710 was being driven
south to north on Edinburgh Road by Yu Kai Sei, permit
No.9840F, employed by Mrs. E. Kelen, 151 Route Magriny, and
when about 200 yards south of Yu Yuen Road a Chinese pedestrian
suddenly attempted to run across the road and was knocked down
by the front bumper of the car.

Japanese Constables No's 158 and 236 who were on duty in
the vicinity were taking particulars of the accident when mem-
bers of the Public Safety Bureau appeared on the scene and
ordered the chauffeur to proceed with the injured person to the
6th Division Station, Jessfield Road.

Inspector Chamberlain attended but upon arrival found
that the chauffeur had already been released after being fined
$2.00 for breach of traffic regulations and ordered to pay
the injured person $1 compensation.

Inspector Chamberlain informed the Inspector on duty
at the 6th Division Station that his men were functioning on
a Municipal Road but did not receive any satisfaction.

6月7日上午9时30分，余凯西（Yu Kai Sei，音译，执照号码9840F）驾驶6710号汽车，由南向北行驶在爱丁堡路上。余受雇于麦格尼路（Route Magriny）151号的E. Kelen夫人。当车辆行驶至愚园路以南约200码处时，一名中国行人突然试图横穿马路，被汽车前保险杠撞倒。

当时在附近执勤的日本巡捕第158号和第236号正在记录事故详情，此时公共安全局人员出现在现场，命令司机载着伤者前往杰司斐德路（Jessfield Road）第六分区捕房。

张伯伦（Chamberlain）巡官赶到现场，但发现司机因违反交通法规被罚款2.00元，并被责令向伤者支付1元赔偿金后，已被释放。

张伯伦巡官告知第六分区捕房的值班巡官，其手下警员是在工部局道路上执行职务，但未得到任何满意的答复。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / C. D. S. B. 登记处。/ 编号 D / 日期 ____ 19__）

办公
这是公共安全局人员在爱丁堡路
干涉我方人员的第二起案件。请将此
记录在案，我对该事的担忧将被证实。

S1. 请知悉
并于今日退回。

At 9.30 a.m. on the 7-6-33, Motor car, No. 710, was being
driven South to North on Edinburgh Road by Yu Hui Sei,
permit No. 9840F, employed by Mrs. E. Kelen, 151 Route
Lagreny, and when about 200 yards South of the Yu Yuen Road
a Chinese pedestrian suddenly attempted to run across the
road and was knocked down by the front bumper of the car.
J.P.C.s 158 and 236 who were on duty in the vicinity
were taking particulars of the accident when members of the
Bureau of Public Safety appeared on the scene and ordered
the chauffeur to proceed with the injured person to the
6th Division Station, Jessfield Road.
Inspector Chamberlain attended but upon arrival found
that the chauffeur had already been released after being
fined $2.00 for breach of traffic regulations and ordered
to pay the injured person $1.00 compensation.
Inspector Chamberlain informed the Inspector on duty
at the 6th Division Station that his men were functioning on
a Municipal Road but did not receive any satisfaction.

ATTEMPTED
SUICIDE OF
CHINESE
PRISONER.

At 3.20 p.m. on the 7-6-33, a prisoner on remand in the
station cells informed one of the Chinese Clerks that a
fellow prisoner named King Sung Sing had swallowed a
number of coins.
The said prisoner was questioned and stated that after
his arrest whilst waiting in the Charge-room to be finger
printed and searched he swallowed 5 20c pieces and about
20 coppers.
Removed to the Police Hospital and detained for treatment.
Arrested at 4.30 a.m. on the 7-6-33 on a charge of loiteri

SEARCH PARTIES.

Walking search parties operated in the district from
1 p.m. to 3 p.m. the 7-6-33, also from 11 p.m. the 7-6-33
to 2 a.m. the 8-6-33.
During the above hours, 14 motor cars, 27 rickshas and a
number of pedestrians were stopped and searched, all correct.

RADIO VAN
No. 25.

The Radio Van operated in the district from 7 p.m. to
9 p.m. the 7-6-33, also from 4 a.m. to 7 a.m. the 8-6-33.
During the above hours, 10 motor cars, 18 rickshas and a
number of pedestrians were stopped and searched, all correct.

PATROL
MOTOR CYCLES
Nos. 20, 26, 31, 34.

Motor Cycle Patrols operated on the extra Settlement
Roads between 7 a.m. the 7-6-33 and 6 a.m. the 8-6-33.
No reports.

1933年6月7日下午3时20分，拘留在捕房牢房内的一名还押囚犯向一名华籍文员报告称，另一名名为金松兴（King Sung Sing，音译）的囚犯吞下了数枚硬币。

At 4.30 p.m. on the 23.5.33, Motor car 9227 driven
by Mrs. J.H. Cubbon, No.28 Edinburgh Road, was leaving the
entrance of the above premises when it collided with M/car
No.10358 driven by one named Ing Miau Lee, No.25 Hardoon
Road, which was proceeding north to south along Edinburgh
Road.

Members of the Bureau of Public Safety appeared on
the scene and took Motor car No.10358 and the chauffeur to
the 6th Division Station, Jessfield, but after particulars
of the accident had been taken both the chauffeur and car
were handed over to S.I. Stokes.

摘录自静安寺捕房1933年5月24日日报。

非法行使职权

1933年5月23日下午4时30分，由居住于爱丁堡路28号的J.H. Cubbon夫人驾驶的9227号汽车，在驶离上述住所入口时，与沿爱丁堡路由北向南行驶的、由名为Ing Miau Lee（音译）的人驾驶的、居住于哈同路（Hardoon Road）25号的10358号汽车发生碰撞。

公共安全局人员出现在现场，将10358号汽车及司机带往杰司斐德路（Jessfield）第六分区捕房，但在记录事故详情后，司机和车辆均被移交给斯托克斯（Stokes）高级巡官（S.I.）。

10358号汽车轻微受损。
9227号汽车未受损。
9227号汽车司机未受干涉。
